text:
**continue**: CL47 holds on the cl47+cl48 merge against main, so feat/streamline-doctor-memory (78df8a0, inside cl47) can land now through `kit.py land` on CL47; land CL48 on top of it.

## Holds
Checked on a merge I made myself: origin/main 90ece47 + origin/cl47 95c356f + origin/cl48 e0194cc (no conflict; the orchestrator's 4d75dc7 is not on the remote, so I rebuilt it), full git history (not shallow).
- **The two phone checks CL41's review found broken: 0 of 2 fail.** `node kit/board/test_page_ux.js` on the merge: 0 failed, the 411 px fold checks included.
- **On CL41's commit they do fail, the same 2.** On a73fa1a (the parent of 0703d5e): 2 failed, exactly "411 px: a tap on the train's name pulls its hidden done step out" and "411 px: the fold is remembered per train across a reload", with the train showing only CL2/CL3 (no done step to fold). That fits CL47's stated cause: the seeded done step never got onto the board.
- **The break makes the check fail.** Applied `sed -i "s/{ 'X-Kit-Gate': 'copy' }/{}/" kit/board/test_page_ux.js` in the merge: the run stops with `seed cl1-done refused: 403 ... a step is complete only after kit.py done ...`. That is the cause written out by the server: 397954d's proof gate, not the page. Put back, it passes.
- **Install check for a present runtime: 4 passed, 3 runs of 3** (`pytest -q tests/test_install_present_runtimes.py` on the merge, full history).
- **Full suite on the merge:** `run_all_tests.py --all` result: see the last line of this section.
- **Real project:** the post's real_project has the Harmonize run (kit 4d75dc7 installed by `install.py --update` on a scratch copy): install rc=0, `.claude/hooks/kit` now holds both guard hooks (the CL41 review's missing-hook case), verify 82 ok / 1 missing (the project's own archived file), resume rc=0. I did not rerun it (only the orchestrator's session holds that repo).
- Not checked: the 101 commits line by line (listed on CL41's post, not re-reviewed by CL47 nor by me); the 2 install failures the first CL41 review saw stay unreproduced (most likely its shallow clone, where one test is skipped and an earlier version of the tree differed).

- **Full suite on the merge: 71 of 71 suites passed, 0 failed** (`python3 scripts/run_all_tests.py --all`, 197 s, KIT_TEST set by the runner, so the guard was on for all of them).

## Goal
The train board-data serves one thing: the board is the one record and it can be trusted, the same everywhere (git, local, the Artifact). CL47's measure (the checks CL41's review saw red are green again, and why) is a stand-in for that, but the right one for its narrow job: unblocking the trunk, which has held 101 commits off main since 11-23. Together with CL48 it shows something no single post says: both breakages of trust found this week came from tests touching real state (the page test hit the real proof gate; the 11-20 install test wrote the real board-mirror). No step in this train has an `asked` entry, so there was no owner example to replay, and none of the last Dones shows the owner trying the result himself.

## Verdict
**continue.** The redirect's three asks are met by reruns, not words: the 2 fold checks pass (and fail on CL41's commit, and fail again under the break), the install check is 4 of 4 three times, the commit list is on CL41's post. **feat/streamline-doctor-memory can now land:** its tip 78df8a0 is an ancestor of cl47, so landing CL47 lands it. Suggestion: land CL47 first (it carries the doctor-memory branch), then CL48 on top; after that, have the owner open the board on his phone once (the trunk then holds 128 new commits he has never seen).
